channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Kubernetes Confidential Containers Get Fortanix Attestation and Key Management
item.description: Fortanix's CoCo integration connects workload attestation to decryption-key release for Kubernetes AI workloads. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: LocalStack for Azure Enters Public Preview with Security Settings Stored but Not Enforced
item.description: LocalStack has opened its Azure emulator to a free public preview, running Azure services locally and accepting existing ARM, Bicep, and Terraform without rewrites. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross-Region Inferencing for OpenAI models in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Terra and Luna) on the bedrock-runtime endpoint, with support for the Responses, Converse, and Chat Completions APIs in AWS GovCloud (US). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Web Search now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: Kiro web search gives the agent real-time access to current information on the internet, so its answers draw on up-to-date search results and page content. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer automatically saves in-progress emails as drafts
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer automatically saves in-progress emails as drafts, helping agents resume work without losing progress when connectivity is interrupted or when their browser is accidentally closed or refreshed. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Daybreak Red from OpenAI now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
item.description: Security teams need powerful tools to find vulnerabilities, test exploits, and build defenses. Daybreak Red from OpenAI is now available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-East), bringing advanced AI to this work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudFront now provides viewer ISP and post-quantum TLS details
item.description: Amazon CloudFront can now forward two new optional headers to your origin. The CloudFront-Viewer-ISP header contains the name of the viewer's internet service provider (ISP), so you can see which network a request came from. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MSK now supports TLS 1.3 for data in transit
item.description: Amazon MSK now supports version 1.3 of Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol for MSK Provisioned clusters through encryption policies. (1 source: aws)
